race.comment: ALABAMA STATE (1) rewarded for his consistency when coming back in grade for a dominant win over 1400m at Rosehill in Midway class. Will appreciate the solid tempo with Newman's 3kg claim. Confidence is high and has genuine each-way claims. JUST IN TIME (8) has made excellent progress this campaign, including her latest on-pace third over 1600m at Eagle Farm in BM78 grade. Lloyd takes the reins and will prove hard to get past. CUBAN CIGAR (5) plagued by wide gates most of his prep and today is no different. Closed strongly from back in the field with a game third over 1600m in the Coonamble Cup. Massive jockey switch today and don't underestimate. MAGICAL MOMENTS (13) sprinted well first up over 1250m at Canterbury, then held her ground to the line when sixth over 1400m at Rosehill. Has more to offer from the right draw and stays in the mix. DUSTY BAY (3) returned to form over the mile in Queensland. Maps well and has to be considered.
